brief: A display stand with the large platform on a spike where three bases meet.

requirements.evidence: Three full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full) form one group; mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 stands at their shared junction, and setSpikeAccessory platform-lrg (51.96 x 60 mm plate) is trapped on it. House rules applied: capOpenFaces (12 solid caps) and lockJoints (3 joint bolts). check_build is ok with meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: Display stand with the large platform on a spike

requirements.evidence: Spike offer s20 was at junction [{0,0},{0,1},{1,0}] — exactly the three bases meeting — and the spike ref encodes all three cells.
requirements.requirement: Platform spike located where three bases meet

finish.summary: Built a compact display stand: three full bases in a triangular cluster, a mount spike at their shared corner junction, and the large platform (platform-lrg) trapped on the spike as the display surface. Open faces capped and joints bolted per house rules; check_build passes with meshClash clear. No display prop was staged because the spike/platform is not a prop-bearing surface in the configurator, so the stand is shown empty and ready to hold an object.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: A spike platform where three bases meet — I'll set up a three-base junction and mount the large platform on its spike.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
